Hessenberg and absorption are used only in their ZF well-orderable-cardinal form. Well-ordering, Zorn, countable-union and successor-aleph regularity enter only local items marked ZFC. Countable-language completeness and compactness do not import AC.

The tree claims are under ZFC, so omega-one boundedness and countable unions have their needed choice strength. Club definitions retain the ambient ordinal and regularity convention, filter means proper filter, ultrafilter extension runs through Zorn, and diamond is conditional; no V=L-to-diamond implication is used.

Finite beth iteration, pattern closure and the general-cardinal theorem use cardinal exponentiation only under ZFC and retain beth_n(kappa)^+ -> (kappa^+)^(n+1)_kappa for every finite n, including zero.
